comparison.objective: Test phone power buttons and sort phones by observed response; candidate finishes installed thread inserts by tang removal and recovery.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed button pressing, state observation, and object sorting versus coaxial mandrel insertion, hammer coordination, controlled fracture, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Hold every button for three seconds and place lit and unlit phones in their respective trays versus fracture all four notches and physically contain all fragments without damage.
comparison.reason: Sorting after functional testing does not test controlled fracture or impact-tool coordination. No spec versions provide additional rubric detail.
